title: Hands-On House Children's Museum

services.name: Museum Admission
services.desc: Pre-purchased tickets are strongly recommended. Walk-in admissions will be available as space allows. To ensure a safe and positive play experience we have a limit on how many guests can be in the museum at one time. On particularly busy days, visits may be limited to 90 mins. Nurses or aides that are accompanying a special needs child with their family or adult guardian will receive free admission with proper identification. Those accompanying a child without another adult will be considered a guardian during the visit and will be charged admission From Memorial Day to Labor Day we offer FREE admission to military members and their immediate family when they present a valid ACTIVE
